# MediaPipe landmark fixtures

These files are verbatim test data from google-ai-edge/mediapipe (Apache-2.0),
the published hand-landmark sets the classifier is checked against.

Source: mediapipe/python/solutions/testdata/ and mediapipe/models/
License: Apache License 2.0 — see https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe

They are vendored (not fetched) so the addon test job is hermetic and does not
depend on upstream paths that may move.
